notes.title: HotFix 11.09.2024 Now Live!
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Totems no longer spawn in boss rooms
[*] Task totem now give rewards after use
[*] Missing loocalization was added
[*] Coin modifiers were reworked to be not so imbalanced
[*] Trean boss now less difficult
[*] Trean boss aoe wave is now more accurate
[*] Gems/Emeralds now properly saved for all party members
[*] Fixed error when boss instantly died
[/list]

notes.title: Arcane Blast is out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680163/acd4fbf82eb659b161976dc343f5dfd4bbce9be3.png[/img][h2]Celebrate game launch with us, watch the broadcast and play Arcane Blast![/h2]

What is "Arcane Blast"?
Arcane Blast is a fast-paced, action-packed roguelike brimming with sorcery. Master the seven elements, combine them to achieve powerful reactions and face swarms of enemies to help feline Mage Adrian find his way home from a time dungeon.
